text:
Alyssa: Heads up - I'm seeing a ~$45k gap between prepaid Dedicated invoices and our revenue schedule for Q1. Flagging before close week.

Maria: Can you drop invoice IDs + schedule rows? rough totals ok.

Alyssa: From billing export:
```
INV-2026-1456, Acme, billed 2026-02-25, total 150000, term 12m, deferred 12500
INV-2026-1499, Bolt, billed 2026-03-03, total 60000, term 6m, deferred 10000
```
Schedule shows Acme OK; Bolt shows 9000/month not 10000 -> 1k x 6 = 6k. There's also a manual allocation in March of -39k = ~45k total.

Kevin: Who posted the -39k? JE ref?

Alyssa: Tagged as `manual_allocation_2026-03-15` by `revenue_ops`. Link to sheet: https://redwood-internal.sheets/s/prepay-recon-03

Kevin: That's my migration script. We had a promo credit on Bolt and my script created an adjustment. I should've left a note.

Priya: For close we need: 1) reconciliation CSV (invoice_id, billed, deferred_balance, schedule_id) 2) proposed JE (GLs + amounts) 3) approver. Can we get before 2pm PT for Sam?

Alyssa: I'll assemble the CSV and flag mismatched rows. Example row I'm adding:
```
INV-2026-1499,Bolt,2026-03,expected 10000,on schedule 9000,delta 1000
```

Kevin: Draft JE rollback to reverse the accidental allocation:
```
DR Deferred Revenue (GL2102) 45,000
CR Unearned Promo Liability (GL2199) 45,000
```

Sam: Include invoice PDFs + billing export + script log. Approve timing? book in March or spread?

Priya: Recommend one-time correction in March close to avoid misstating this quarter.

Alyssa: Uploaded attachments to the sheet and pinned rows, tagged @sam.

Sam: Reviewing now. If backup matches, I'll approve JE. Kevin - pause automation for that customer (ticket TICK-4821).

Kevin: Pausing automation for Bolt and running dry-run fix. Will post diff to ticket.

Alyssa: Adding JE ref to close checklist.

Sam: Approved contingent on attachments matching. :white_check_mark:

Priya: I'll refresh the revenue schedule after JE and notify accounting watchers.

Alyssa: Closing loop - booked one-time correction in March and schedules now reconcile. Will follow up with a short RCA on promo proration bug.

Kevin: RCA will add test coverage so promo credits net into proration. Will link PR when ready.
